title: Data-Efficient Strategies for Expanding Hate Speech Detection into Under-Resourced Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance (Macro F1) of monolingual and multilingual transformer models on hate speech detection tasks across five under-resourced, non-English languages (Arabic, Spanish, Hindi, Portuguese, and Italian) using target-language test sets and the Multilingual HateCheck (MHC) suite to measure and mitigate the performance gap compared to high-resource English models.
